neighbours.label: ' time' inside a negated or limiting phrase ('no time', 'not enough time', 'never found the time', 'not spare much time'), where the negation is what makes the pole fire
fire: The surgeon had no time to spare, so the patient was rushed straight into the operating room.
Our team did not have enough time to finish the report before the deadline passed.
They wasted no time in opening a second location across the river.
Without enough time to plan, the wedding guests simply did not show up at the venue.
Nobody on the crew had any time to rest between the two long shifts.
He could not spare much time for the meeting, so he left early without saying goodbye.
The county never found the time to repair the bridge, despite repeated complaints from drivers.
Honestly, the committee had almost no time left once the budget fight finally ended.
quiet: The surgeon had no room to spare, so the patient was rushed straight into the operating room.
Our team had plenty of time to finish the report before the deadline arrived.

Her answer was quite likely, given the evidence the detectives had gathered so far.
